sentences.text: This animal was a marine crocodyliform belonging to the family Metriorhynchidae.
It is classified within the subfamily Metriorhynchinae of that same family.
The genus was described by Parrilla-Bel and colleagues in 2013.
The group contains two species, with the second one named in 2018.
The time range for this animal spans from the Callovian to the Kimmeridgian, between 165.3 and 149.2 million years ago.
One species is known from the Late Jurassic Sabinal Formation in Oaxaca, Mexico.
The other lived in Spain during the Middle Jurassic Middle Callovian.
